Native-safe browser-only behaviour (contract rules 4,5,7): (a) usePageTitle feature-detects document.title and no-ops on bare native instead of throwing. (b) fmtInt try/catches Intl.NumberFormat and falls back to a rounded string when the host runtime lacks Intl. (c) The web DataTable's localStorage-backed column layout/width persistence (keyed by tableId) has no native analogue, so tableId is accepted but unused and the table is a static horizontal-scroll grid; this is a deliberate, explicit reduction documented here, not missing data — every column and row still renders.
